title: Rain on the radar
description: data of: rain.py --json. The nearest rain on RainViewer's composite radar round the site, its movement, and when rain upwind reaches the site and for how long.

picture.description: HH:MM local, the radar picture's time.

nearest_km.description: null: no rain on the map (about 250 km each way).

rain_share.description: Fraction of the map with rain.

movement_from.description: Whether the movement is the rain's own or the satellite's cloud.

moving_from.description: Compass point the rain comes from.

arrives_min.description: Minutes until rain upwind reaches the site; 0 now; null none within 4 h.

lasts_min.description: Minutes the rain lasts on the track; null when its end is beyond the map.
